description: This file implements core CoAP protocol functionalities for Zephyr OS, including packet initialization, option handling, request processing, block transfer, and observer management.

methods.name: coap_packet_init
methods.description: Initializes a CoAP packet with header, token, and other parameters.

methods.name: coap_ack_init
methods.description: Initializes a CoAP acknowledgment packet based on a request.

methods.name: coap_header_set_code
methods.description: Sets the message code in a CoAP packet.

methods.name: coap_header_get_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version field from a CoAP packet.

methods.name: coap_header_get_type
methods.description: Retrieves the message type from a CoAP packet.

methods.name: coap_header_get_code
methods.description: Retrieves the code field from a CoAP packet.

methods.name: coap_header_get_id
methods.description: Retrieves the message ID from a CoAP packet.

methods.name: coap_packet_get_payload
methods.description: Returns pointer and length of payload data in a CoAP packet.

methods.name: coap_uri_path_match
methods.description: Checks if the URI path options match a given path array, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: coap_handle_request_len
methods.description: Handles incoming request packets, dispatching to appropriate resource methods.

methods.name: coap_resource_notify
methods.description: Notifies all observers of a resource.

methods.name: coap_observer_init
methods.description: Initializes a CoAP observer with request info and address.

methods.name: coap_register_observer
methods.description: Registers an observer for a resource.

methods.name: coap_remove_observer
methods.description: Removes an observer from a resource.

methods.name: coap_find_observer
methods.description: Finds an observer by address, token, and token length.

methods.name: net_coap_init
methods.description: Initializes the CoAP subsystem, seeding message ID.

methods.name: coap_next_id
methods.description: Returns the next message ID, incrementing the static counter.
